svg.title: Artifact viewer for Toy Box
svg.desc: A native 1280 by 840 point channel window with a readable Markdown artifact replacing the conversation and inspector. The channel sidebar stays, native Back, Share and More controls frame the document, and the existing image-gallery capsule moves between artifacts. Supporting detail excerpts show interactive HTML, a natively rendered SVG in Dark appearance, and an explicit loading failure. Materials are schematic, not native-rendering evidence.

g.text: A proposal for Toy Box 0.1.5. Same gallery chrome, a renderer suited to each file. Materials are schematic.
Bring the team's decisions, work and evidence into one place.
Keep the window calm. Make the next action unmistakable.
Know what needs you. Requests stay close, wherever you work.
Answer in context. The question and your reply stay together.
See the result. Designs and prototypes open in one viewer.
// Keep the work inside its channel.
Read the plan, try the prototype, inspect the drawing.
Then go back to the exact message and draft you left.
Only the selected item is live.
Same frame, different kinds of work
Detail excerpts. The file supplies the content. Toy Box supplies a consistent way in, through and back.
An interactive page, right where the team shared it.
From an idea to a release
Fit, magnify and pan. No scripts to display a drawing.
The server could not load this file.
HTML is interactive, with an opaque origin and no host access.
SVG uses the shared bounded native decoder.
A failure keeps Back and the other artifacts available.
The strip is shared across types. Arrows never hijack text input. Loaded content stays put until the person navigates or reloads.
